observations: Actual v6b player completed idle-wave-idle on normal loading with one completion callback and no image error.
Final candidate also completed with fixed 1200ms delay per wave atlas page.
Deliberate missing wave image emitted a launcher failure and retained the common anchor rather than displaying a blank or switching to legacy art.
Previous same-source runtime checks passed rapid 8 switches, dialog completion, 390x844 viewport and reduced-motion/hidden simulations.
Both bridge endpoints and fallback equal the accepted idle anchor in actual RGBA; transition imagery inspected by independent art review and root.
limits: Screenshot observations sample playback, not uninterrupted video observation or a guarantee of imperceptible transitions.
Simulated network latency is not a physical mobile network throughput test.
Failure injection tested lower-level canvas; production host fallback completion is verified by code review, not this isolated canvas harness.
Minor texture softness remains between generated action and frozen idle; no severe body deformation or 2D-to-3D material jump was found.
Production browser acceptance is a separate post-deployment check and remains pending.
